description: The line plot illustrates the loss ratio as a function of TFLOPs for different methods compared to Vanilla. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at each power of ten. The y-axis, labeled "Loss Ratio (%)," ranges from 94% to 100%, with tick labels at every 1% interval. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different method. The Vanilla method is depicted with a purple line and triangle markers, remaining constant at 100% across all TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64) method is shown with an orange line and square markers, starting at approximately 97% and peaking near 100% before slightly declining towards the end. The SepLLM (n=128) method is represented by a green line with diamond markers, beginning around 96% and increasing to just below 100%. The SepLLM (n=64, H) method is indicated by a red line with circle markers, starting at about 95% and rising to just above 100%. Lastly, the SepLLM (n=64, H/T) method is depicted with a blue line and cross markers, beginning at approximately 94% and increasing to around 99%.
